title: Case Study Writer I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 47. Turns a proof point into a public case-study draft in a situation/approach/result structure, naming a client ONLY if docs/permission-register.yaml shows CLEARED status. Nothing is CLEARED today, so every case study ships client-free in practice.

situation.description: The client-free starting problem, in the CFO's own words where possible.

approach.description: What Canvas Intelligence actually did — an architecture fact or delivery detail.

result.description: The one metric or artefact this case study is built around. Never fabricated.

campaign.description: utm_campaign value for the single call to action.

client_reference.description: Optional client name the caller wants named. Checked against docs/permission-register.yaml with default-deny semantics before it may ever be surfaced in output; nothing is CLEARED today.

client_named.description: True only when a client_reference was supplied AND permission_check.check_clearance confirms it is CLEARED in docs/permission-register.yaml; false when no client_reference was supplied or the reference is UNCLEARED (default-deny).
